title: Big Surprise locked-audio alignment execution intake

plan.objective: Prepare the exact binary-intake and execution controls needed to run the review-only WhisperX and Yass comparison.
steps: Mount the exact locked WAV and verify its SHA-256.
Review local WhisperX, vocal-separation, and Yass versions and licenses.
Run the adapters without changing lyric text or final BeatMap 001.
Normalize outputs and compute line-start, line-end, coverage, and exception metrics.
Return a review-only candidate; prohibit automatic promotion.

findings.message: The final audio filename and fingerprint are known, but the exact WAV bytes are not mounted for execution.
The experiment may produce review evidence only and cannot automatically replace final BeatMap 001.

next_gate: Expose the exact locked WAV as downloadable bytes, verify its hash, and approve the local tool versions before execution.
